description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Race is a running event held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run along the cool trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes several races over distances of 15 km, 7 km and 3 km, as well as a race for families, making it suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Participants can enjoy a natural, scenic and healthy setting, away from paved roads.
course_highlights: Route along the cool trails of Hoia Forest
Various distances: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km and a family race
Event held in nature, away from paved roads
additional: The event includes a registration package with a T-shirt and race number. Races are held for all ages, including one dedicated to families. The route follows natural forest trails, offering a running experience in nature. The race starts in the evening, creating a special night-race atmosphere. The participation fee includes a medal, timing and medical assistance. Registration is exclusively online, with entries open until June 13, 2026.

name: CROSUL 15 NOIEMBRIE
description: The 15 November Run is an annual sporting event held in Brașov, commemorating the Anti-Communist Revolt of 15 November 1987 by workers at the Roman Truck Factory. The main event is a 5-kilometre road race along the historic route of the revolt, open to all running enthusiasts. There are also races for children, with distances adapted to their ages, promoting physical activity and team spirit. The event is organized by Brașov City Hall in partnership with the 15 November 1987 Brașov Association and the Together for Movement Sports Club.
course_highlights: A historic 5 km route along the streets associated with the 1987 Brașov Revolt
An urban road route through Brașov, including historic and cultural landmarks
Children’s races from 250 m to 1.2 km, adapted for different age groups
additional: Registration is free and limited to 1,800 participants (1,500 adults and 300 children). Race kits can be collected the day before at the Sport Guru Brașov store between 15:30 and 20:00. The race starts inside the SC Roman industrial park, right outside the former Section 440 of the Truck Factory, where the revolt began. Running on the streets of Brașov, a 5 km route, races for all ages, commemorative event, organized in November 2025

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a mountain running event celebrating Romania on National Day, held in Cluj-Napoca. In its 9th edition in 2026, the event offers a variety of routes, including a 50 km ultramarathon, team races, a half marathon, a cross-country race, and children’s races. Participants can support one of Romania’s 9 historical regions while enjoying scenic landscapes and a friendly atmosphere. The main 50 km route passes through natural and urban areas, with well-organized hydration and refreshment stations. The event also includes a live broadcast, modern facilities, and prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: The Ultra 50k route passes through forests, urban areas, and ski slopes around Cluj
Hydration and refreshment stations offer water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and sweets
The final 12 km are predominantly downhill, with just one climb of more than 100 m
additional: The runner’s kit includes a race bib with timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and live rankings, a finisher’s medal, and access to hydration and refreshment stations offering sweet and savory products, still and sparkling water, isotonic drinks, supplements, and fruit. A refund policy is available if announced by November 9, 2026. Time limits are 9h for Ultra 50k, 5h for Half 25k, 3h for Cross 15k, and 1h30 for Mini EcoTrail 7k. The event also includes Play&Run children’s races and an awards ceremony at 15:00. Race distances include Ultra 50k, Half 25k, Cross 15k, Mini EcoTrail 7k, and children’s races; events take place from November 28 to December 1, 2026, with exhibitions, kit distribution, and awards ceremonies.

name: MARATON 1 DECEMBRIE
description: The 1 December Marathon is an annual competition held in IOR Park in Bucharest, open to runners of all levels. The event offers an enjoyable sporting experience, with well-organized courses and a friendly atmosphere. Participants can receive race kits and attentive organizational support, helping ensure a safe and motivating race. The marathon also supports charitable causes, bringing the community together for a worthy purpose.
course_highlights: Course held in IOR Park, Bucharest
Race kits handed directly to participants or to a representative with the required documents
Race kit collection available over the three days before the race
additional: Race kits can be collected over the three days before the race at locations in Bucharest: SportGuru Store (69 Unirii Boulevard) and ParkLake Shopping Center. Kits are handed only to the registered and validated participant, upon presentation of an identity document. Another person may collect a kit only with a signed copy of the participant’s identity document. For the teenagers’ race, the kit is handed only to the minor, accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who signs a declaration of physical and medical fitness. Participation includes races for different categories and supports charitable causes; the event has a tradition of promoting an active and healthy lifestyle.

name: OVB Charity RUN
description: OVB Charity Run is a charity race organized in Cluj-Napoca, dedicated to runners of all levels who want to support a worthy cause through sport. The event offers an enjoyable running experience in a friendly setting, promoting the local running community and social engagement. This is the first edition of the race, inviting participants to enjoy running and contribute to the common good.
course_highlights: 6 km course in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca
Supports the 'Saint Nectarios' Palliative Care Center for seriously ill children
Race options of 2 km (family, non-competitive) and 6 km (competitive)
additional: Participants can register until December 5, 2025; the event takes place in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca, and supports the pediatric cause through donations and sponsorships.

Everesting+ Ultra Zărand
description: Ultra Zarand Everesting+ is an extreme mountain running race held in Căsoaia, Arad County, Romania, on 11-12 December 2026. The event offers two challenging distances: 172 km with 9,250 m of elevation gain, rated difficult, and 86 km with 4,600 m of elevation gain, rated intermediate. The race is known for its demanding mountain terrain and Everesting challenge, making it suitable for experienced runners seeking a top-level endurance competition. Participants can track their performance on a personalized results dashboard.
course_highlights: Distances of 86 km and 172 km with 4,600 m and 9,250 m of elevation gain, respectively
Mountain terrain rated intermediate and difficult
Everesting event with extreme endurance challenges
additional: The event has a personalized dashboard for tracking participants’ results. No entry-fee details or start times are provided. The race has a UTMB index for both distances, indicating international recognition of its difficulty. The event also includes a 10 km race to promote local tourism and natural and cultural heritage, offering a unique opportunity for ultramarathon and mountain running enthusiasts.

name: Semimaraton „Pe Argeș în Jos”
description: The “Pe Argeș în Jos” Half Marathon is an annual sporting event held in the heart of Pitești, bringing together runners of all levels. The courses start in Ștrand Park, pass through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks, and continue along the Argeș River promenade, offering a distinctive natural and urban setting for running. The event includes races for all ages and fitness levels, from children’s races to the 21 km half marathon, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The atmosphere is vibrant, with supporters, music, and prizes for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Ștrand Park, near the Summer Theatre
Course through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks
Run along the Argeș River promenade, with picturesque views
additional: Race kit collection is on December 12 at EF Store and on December 14 at the Summer Theatre for participants from outside Pitești. The half marathon, 5 km, and 10 km races start at 10:00 in Ștrand Park. The children’s race starts at 12:30, and the awards ceremony is at 13:00. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal representative when registering and collecting their race kit. The event includes online registration, race kit collection on 12.12.2026, and access to results and photos after the event.

The event is for runners of all ages, with clearly defined age categories, and emphasizes sportsmanship and the outdoor experience. Participants receive personalized race kits and finisher medals, while the top finishers are awarded prizes by category. The race starts in the morning, and the routes are clearly marked, with refreshment points along the way.

10.5 km cross route with a time limit of 2 hours
Start and finish in Ion C. Brătianu Park, Oradea

The half-marathon route has three refreshment points, while the cross/mini route has one. Participants must wear their race number visibly on their clothing. Trail-running shoes are recommended. Minors must have parental consent.

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail running race held in Băneasa Forest in Bucharest. It has grown organically since its first edition in 2018, reaching more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: half marathon (21 km), cross-country (11 km), sprint (6 km), and Family Run (3 km), so every runner can find the right challenge. The varied courses include trails, dirt roads, and asphalt, offering an enjoyable experience in nature, with well-positioned refreshment stations. Băneasa Forest Run is about the joy of running in the forest, whether you run competitively or for fun with your family.
course_highlights: 100% trail routes in Băneasa Forest, with trails, dirt roads, and asphalt
A range of distances: half marathon 21 km, cross-country 11 km, sprint 6 km, and Family Run 3 km
Refreshment stations at the start, km 3.3, km 5, km 9, and the finish, with water, isotonic drink, and food
additional: The routes may include elevation changes, roots, and vegetation; rain may bring puddles and mud. Group training sessions are organized for different paces, with coordinators. Refreshment stations along the routes offer water, isotonic drink, and food.

name: Cheile Turzii Race
location: Rezervația Naturală Cheile Turzii, Cluj County, Romania
description: Cheile Turzii Race is a mountain running competition held in the heart of Transylvania, in the Cheile Turzii Nature Reserve, Romania. The event offers two races: a 9 km cross-country race with 680 m of elevation gain and a 23 km half marathon with 1,300 m of elevation gain, on technical and spectacular routes featuring dramatic scenery and mountain trails. Participants can experience running beneath limestone cliffs, crossing bridges over the Hășdate River, and climbing to impressive panoramic viewpoints. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners seeking authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Technical routes on mountain trails and forest roads
Spectacular scenery featuring limestone cliffs and dramatic gorges
Climb to Crucea Sănduleștilor with 360° views of the Apuseni Mountains
additional: The start and finish are in front of the Cheile Turzii Mountain Rescue Base. The race kit includes a customized fabric drawstring bag and a finisher medal; the technical T-shirt or singlet is purchased separately. There are aid and hydration stations along the route with water, cola, isotonic drink, fruit, and snacks. Race kits can be collected on Friday, April 17, between 16:00 and 20:00 in Cluj-Napoca (Iulius Mall), and at Cheile Turzii between 19:00 and 21:00, with collection also available on race morning. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:30 at the Mihai Viteazu Town Hall Cabin. Mountain routes, two races, tourism promotion, maximum 400 participants.

Maratonul Argonauților
description: The Argonauts Marathon is a running competition held in the Cheile and Gura Dobrogei area, a scenic region of Romania. The marathon course includes 1,600 meters of positive elevation gain. The event is organized by the Activ Pontica Sports Association and offers participants a unique experience in nature on routes that showcase the beauty of Dobrogea’s nature reserves. In addition to the marathon, other races are held, including a half marathon, a cross-country race, a family race, and the Cheile circuit, welcoming a broad range of runners. The marathon has a tradition and a story inspired by the Argonauts, heroes of Greek mythology, which add a special charm to the competition.

name: La Petrovaselo în vie
description: Petrovaselo in the Vineyard is a sporting event dedicated to running in nature, organized to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage more people to take up outdoor running. Organized by Clubul Sportiv Asociația Alergotura in partnership with Petro Vaselo Winery, the event offers three races of varying distances along scenic routes in the Petro Vaselo vineyard area. Participants can enjoy an outdoor sporting experience with well-marked routes and refreshment stations in a friendly, well-organized setting. After the race, participants are invited to relax with goulash and wine, provided upon presentation of their race number.

name: Medieval Trail Race
description: Medieval Trail Race is a mountain running competition held in Arad County, Romania, along the hiking trails of the Zărand Mountains, between the towns of Șoimoș and Șiria. The event promotes both mountain running and the area’s natural and historical heritage, linking the Șoimoș and Șiria fortresses, as well as other points of interest, along the route. The courses offer an adventurous experience with spring scenery and a medieval atmosphere, and are suitable for both amateurs and professionals. The 2026 edition is the 5th and is part of the ITRA National League and UTMB Index calendars.

name: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge
description: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge is a mountain running competition taking place on April 19, 2026, in the village of Dălhăuți, Vrancea County. The event is organized by the Velopower Sports Association and promotes running over varied terrain, including forest trails and forest roads. Participants can enjoy a well-marked route with checkpoints and a friendly atmosphere, rounded off with an awards ceremony and a traditional lunch. The start is scheduled for 10:00, following a technical briefing and a coffee-fueled warm-up. The event emphasizes socializing and promoting outdoor exercise.

name: Brăila 10K
description: Brăila 10K is a running race held in Monument Park in Brăila on April 19, 2026, offering an energizing and welcoming experience for runners of all ages. The event includes 10.5 km, 7 km, and 3.5 km races, children’s races, and a 1.5 km Family Fun Run, making it ideal for setting a personal record on a fast, well-marked course. The festival atmosphere, music, prizes, and activities for the whole family make Brăila 10K a celebration of outdoor exercise and health. The organizers emphasize safety and the smooth running of the competition, with volunteers and referees present along the course.

name: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom
description: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom is Romania’s first charitable mountain biking race, now in its 14th edition. The event takes place in the town of Urlați, Prahova County, on April 25, 2026, among the area’s hills, vineyards, and wineries. Participants can choose from several routes suited to their ability, ranging from 4 km for children to 50 km for experienced cyclists. The race promotes cycling as a healthy lifestyle and supports important social causes.
course_highlights: 50 km route for experienced cyclists
30 km route for amateur cyclists and juniors
18 km route recommended for less experienced cyclists
additional: The children’s races (4 and 8 km) start at 09:00, the 18, 30, and 50 km routes at 10:35, and the Family Ride at 10:45. Race packs can be collected in Bucharest and at the venue during specified time slots. Family Ride participants do not receive a race kit and may go directly to the start. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00, and the cutoff time is 16:30. The event also includes activities for families and children, supports social and educational causes, and promotes wine culture and local tourism.

description: Alergăraș în Făgăraș is a sporting event that brings together runners of all ages and performance levels to explore the natural and cultural beauty of the Făgăraș area. The courses offer a complete experience, with steep climbs, descents through spectacular scenery, and well-organized hydration points, while the start and finish take place near the historic fortress. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, supported by an enthusiastic community and dedicated volunteers. The event promotes grassroots sport and respect for nature, offering a memorable day of running and socializing amid mountain scenery.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and descents through spectacular scenery
Start and finish in the area of Făgăraș Fortress
Well-stocked hydration points and excellent course marking
additional: Premium finisher medal, cash prizes for podium finishers, ITRA points and a UTMB Index for the Maratonu’ de pe Ardeal and Belvedere races, a voucher for a hot meal after the race, medical support with an ambulance, a massage tent, food and hydration points along the course and at the finish, and the option to purchase a technical running shirt. Multiple race categories, including marathon, trail, cross-country, and relays; the event includes cultural and tourist activities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the natural beauty of the Făgăraș area.

name: RotaRun 2026
description: RotaRun for Charity is a sporting and charitable event organized by Rotary Club Cluj-Napoca, combining running with community involvement to support children with cancer. The event on April 25, 2026, aims to complete the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department at the “Prof. Dr. Ion Chiricuță” Oncology Institute in Cluj-Napoca. Participants can choose from several races, ranging from a 3 km run to a 2-hour race, all held along the Someș Promenade, with the start and finish near the “Horia Demian” Sports Hall. All funds raised through registration fees go directly to the charitable project.

name: Maratonul Codrului
description: The 5th edition of Maratonul Codrului is an event organized by Club Sportiv Pro Racers and the Romanian Cycling Federation, taking place on April 25, 2026, at Lake Oţeloaia, Satu Mare. It is a competition for both amateurs and professionals, featuring MTB and Trail Run events on spectacular forest trails, with challenges for all levels. The event offers new and more challenging MTB routes, as well as hobby events with shorter routes to encourage participation. There is also a special race for children, and participants receive a start pack, timing, hydration points, medical assistance, a pasta party, and finisher medals.

name: The Color Run București
description: The Color Run București is an untimed 5 km race full of color and energy, celebrating health, joy, and originality. Participants start wearing white and are covered in colored powder at every kilometer, culminating in a vibrant party at the finish. The event takes place on April 25, 2026, in Bucharest, along Bd. Unirii and the surrounding areas, offering a festive experience accessible to all ages. It is a celebration of movement and community, with special moments such as a cloud of colored powder and live music.

name: Forest Race Marghita
description: Forest Race Marghita is a trail-running competition of moderate difficulty, held in the deciduous forest near the town of Marghita. The event is organized by Run For Freedom Sports Club together with XTERRA Sport Bihor Sports Club and offers four different routes tailored to various levels of runners. The start and finish are at Freedom Adventure Park, and the routes are well marked along forest roads. The competition promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.

description: Iași Half Marathon is the largest running event in northeastern Romania, held annually in the Palace of Culture Square. The half-marathon course consists of two loops that pass through the start area, giving runners a unique experience on the city’s main streets, with road traffic stopped and refreshment points along the way. The event has a strong charitable component, supporting children from disadvantaged backgrounds through educational and social projects. Taking part in the half-marathon, cross-country races and fun runs is an opportunity to do good and join a community committed to positive change.
course_highlights: Route along main streets with road traffic stopped
Passes in front of the Palace of Culture
Refreshment points for hydration and medical assistance
additional: Participants in the half-marathon, 10 km cross-country and 5 km cross-country races receive a disposable timing chip and a technical event T-shirt. Registration is available online until the deadline; after that, subject to availability, participants can register in person at the Iași Half Marathon kiosk in Palas Mall. Registration is not available on race day. The event provides an ambulance for medical assistance and plenty of photos at the finish and along the course. Participation includes hydration points, medical assistance, a race kit, and the option to participate online or in person. The event is charitable, supporting projects for disadvantaged children.

name: Bucharest International Half Marathon
description: Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță brings runners to the streets of Bucharest in a race initiated by Olympic marathon champion Constantina Diță. The event includes a half marathon and a 10 km race, open to both competitive and amateur runners. The course is flat and fast, suitable for those aiming for a good result or wanting to enjoy a run in the capital.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course
Running on the streets of Bucharest
Half marathon and 10 km races
additional: Individual, family, and friends registrations are mentioned, as well as the Team 3 Challenge.

name: URME PE PLAY
description: Urme pe Play is a mountain running competition held in the commune of Rășinari, at the foot of the Cindrel and Lotru Mountains. The routes are marked and include natural trails, forest roads, and paved roads, offering an authentic foothill experience. The event is open to both adults and children, with races for each age group. Participants can enjoy picturesque scenery and the friendly atmosphere of the local community at an event that combines sport with local culture and tradition.

name: Sălciua Trail Run
description: Sălciua Trail Run 2026 is an outdoor running competition held in the commune of Sălciua, situated between the Trascău Mountains and Muntele Mare, offering spectacular views. The event brings together people passionate about running, nature, culture, and fun, providing an opportunity to get away from everyday life and enjoy the beauty of nature in the company of loved ones. The competition includes four races: Cursa Zmeilor (28 km), Crosul Liliecilor (15 km), Family and Young Run (5 km), and Cursa Spiridușilor (400–800 m), open to all participants who meet the age and registration requirements. The organizers provide a complete experience, with race kits, an awards ceremony, and themed workshops for all ages.

name: Chindia City Race
description: Chindia City Race is a traditional running event held in the heart of the Târgoviște Citadel, right next to the iconic Chindia Tower. The event takes place on May 2, 2026, in Tricolorului Square, and brings together participants of all ages in a festive atmosphere of friendly competition. The race starts at 10:00 and celebrates the spirit and history of the city, inviting runners to test their speed and endurance on an energetic urban course steeped in tradition.

name: Még egy kört / Încă o rundă - Trail challenge
location: Világlátó, Sfântu Gheorghe, Covasna County, Romania
description: Még egy kört este is a trail running challenge held on the outskirts of Sfântu Gheorghe, in a wooded, hilly area known as “Világlátó.” Participants can run or take part in Nordic walking for 2, 4, or 6 hours, aiming to complete as many 1.6 km laps as possible, each with 60 m of elevation gain. The event is designed as a mental and physical challenge, with a pleasant atmosphere, music, and an on-site bar. It’s a great opportunity for runners and others to test themselves in a friendly natural setting.

name: Crosul de noapte
description: Crosul de Noapte - Delonghi is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants two distances: 4 km and 10 km. The event takes place on May 8, 2026, and is suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a nighttime sporting experience in the city. It is an excellent opportunity to run in an urban setting with a friendly and competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: 4 km and 10 km distances
Night run in Cluj-Napoca
Urban course accessible to all levels
additional: The event includes well-marked courses, online registration, and a safe environment for participants.

description: The Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță is an international half marathon held on some of Bucharest’s most beautiful and fastest streets, offering both professional athletes and amateur runners the opportunity to achieve a competitive personal best. The event also includes 10 km races, races for people with mobility impairments, and a 3.5 km fun run for all ages. The race kit includes a bib with chip timing and a finisher’s medal, while the official T-shirt is optional. The organizer is the Constantina Diță Sports Club Association, and the event is supported by major partners such as Decathlon.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on Bucharest’s main streets
World Athletics Label-certified half marathon course

The event celebrates 15 years of tradition and community and is passionately organized by Clubul Alpin Român Filiala Cluj. A festival atmosphere and sporting challenge come together to create a memorable experience in nature.

name: ROMANAȚI Trail Run, editia a V-a ~ 6 iunie 2026
description: Romanați Trail Run is a vibrant mountain running race held in Caracal, turning the city into the capital of trail running for a day. The event offers three challenging courses suitable for runners of all levels, with a friendly atmosphere and a community passionate about staying active. The race is both sporting and charitable in nature, promoting the values of sport and team spirit. The competition is scheduled to start at 10:00, and participants can choose between a half marathon and two cross-country races.

name: Tinca Cross
description: Tinca Cross is a running competition organized by ACS Bihorul Oradea in partnership with Tinca Town Hall and the Local Council, taking place on June 7, 2026. The event includes 5 km and 10 km cross-country races, suitable for endurance runners aged 14 and over. The course starts at Tinca communal stadium and follows a 2.5 km loop through the forest next to the stadium, finishing at the stadium. Participants under 18 need written consent from a parent or guardian. Cash prizes and diplomas are awarded to the top finishers.

name: SepsiRun
description: SepsiRun is a running festival held in the city of Sfântu Gheorghe and its surroundings. Its goal is to become the largest running event in the area, attracting over 1,000 participants from across the country. The event features several races on urban and trail routes, suitable for all experience levels, with distances ranging from 5 km to 23 km. SepsiRun offers a complete running experience, combining nature and the city with varied routes and a welcoming atmosphere for runners.

name: Pedală în Bănie ~ 2026
distance_verbose: Maraton, 24 km, 14 km, 3000 metri, 1.53 km, 0.6 km
description: Pedală în Bănie is a longstanding sporting event in the Dolj region, dedicated to mountain biking and trail running enthusiasts. Held in the Palilula area of Craiova, the event offers routes inspired by the “JURASSIC” theme, with challenges that test participants’ strength, speed, and endurance. With a variety of races for all ages and ability levels, Pedală în Bănie promotes health, community spirit, and environmental protection, offering a complete experience of competition and adventure in nature. Its friendly atmosphere and thoughtful organization make it a celebration of sport and outdoor activity.

name: Retezat Sky Race
description: Retezat SkyRace is a skyrunning race held amid the spectacular scenery of Romania’s Retezat Mountains, offering runners a challenging experience on varied, technical mountain trails. The event combines the demands of rugged terrain with the natural beauty of ridges, valleys, and alpine lakes, and is intended for mountain-running and adventure enthusiasts. Organized with careful attention to safety and respect for the environment, the race brings together a passionate community and offers opportunities to socialize and push personal limits. On June 13, 2026, participants can experience a true mountain adventure in the heart of the Retezat Mountains.

name: Maraton Maramureș
description: Maramureș Marathon is a mountain race held amid the picturesque scenery of Baia Mare and its surroundings on June 13, 2026. The routes include a 13 km run and hike, a 21 km mountain half marathon, and a full 42 km marathon, each offering challenges and spectacular views. Participants will tackle sustained climbs, trails along the shore of Firiza Dam, and areas with impressive panoramas of the local peaks. The event is suitable both for experienced mountain runners and for those seeking a trail-running experience in nature.

description: Scaunul Domnului Marathon is a challenging mountain race held in the Scaunul Domnului Nature Reserve, near Deda, Mureș. The event offers several events, including a 42 km marathon, a 21 km half marathon, a 10 km cross-country race, and races for families and children. The routes combine sustained climbs, forest roads, and sections with spectacular views, making them suitable for mountain runners eager for adventure and nature. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment checks and checkpoints along the route.

name: Maratonul Sării
description: The Salt Marathon is a sporting event that combines running and mountain biking, set in the natural and historic landscape of Târgu Ocna, Bacău County. Participants can choose between 10 km and 21 km trail-running races, as well as a 30 km mountain-bike race, all starting and finishing in the Town Hall Square. A unique feature of the competition is a 7 km section through the underground galleries of the Târgu Ocna Salt Mine, offering an unusual experience and health benefits thanks to the ionized air. The event promotes an active lifestyle and responsible stewardship of nature, and includes plogging activities to clean up the routes.

name: Maraton Tarcău

description: Tarcău Marathon is an annual competition held in the natural landscape of the Tarcău area in Neamț, offering marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country races. The event emphasizes physical preparation and suitable equipment, ensuring a complete and safe sporting experience. Participants can collect their race kit the day before the competition and must follow the official race rules. Cutoff times are clearly set for each race, ensuring a competitive and well-organized event.

name: Atinge OMU
description: Atinge Omu is a mountain running race held in the Bucegi Mountains on the Peștera–Omu Peak–Peștera route. The event takes place in the first ten days of June, when the landscape is dominated by ridges reddened by rhododendrons. The race offers runners a combination of intensity and natural beauty, and at the finish, participants are rewarded with grilled bulz and jintiță. It is an authentic mountain experience, starting from the Peștera cable car station, with a friendly, traditional atmosphere.

name: Semimaratonul Eroilor Invictus
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon, which will take place on May 23, 2026, in Bistrița, is a sporting event dedicated to commemorating Heroes’ Day and promoting mass-participation sports. The event brings together the local community and amateur athletes, offering a half-marathon and other sporting events. The route starts in Central Square and passes along the city’s main streets. The event is held under the patronage of Prince Radu, with support from several local institutions and associations. Participants are encouraged to read the rules, register, and donate to support the cause.

description: Scaunul Domnului Marathon is a challenging mountain race held in the Scaunul Domnului Nature Reserve, near Bistra Mureșului. The event offers several races, including a 42 km marathon with over 2,100 m of elevation gain, a half marathon, a 10 km cross-country race, and races for families and children. The marathon course passes through spectacular scenery, with aid and checkpoint stations, and includes sections of forest road, unmarked trails, and scenic viewpoints. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment checks and time limits for each race. The atmosphere is rounded out by an awards ceremony and a campfire after the race.

name: The Color Run Iași
description: The Color Run Iași 2026 is an untimed 5-kilometer race full of color and positive energy, celebrating health, joy, and originality. Participants start in white clothes and are showered with powder at every kilometer, finishing the race in a vibrant cloud of colors. The event takes place in front of the Palace of Culture in Iași and offers a festival atmosphere with music and fun for all ages, making it perfect for a memorable day with friends and family. It is an experience accessible to everyone, including children and people with disabilities, with free registration or a full-kit option.

name: PENIEL TRAIL RUN
description: Peniel Trail Run is a trail-running event held on trails in the Bistrița area. It promotes health through exercise, community, and truth. The event offers races for all levels, from a half marathon for experienced runners to 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a children’s race. Peniel Trail Run is more than a sporting competition: it is an invitation to live fully in body, mind, and spirit, with a profound message about direction and a living relationship with God. The name Peniel symbolizes “the place of encounter,” where sport, community, and faith meet in an authentic way that resonates with today’s generation.

name: Crosul Supereroilor
description: The Superheroes Run is an energizing race that brings together thousands of participants in Cluj-Napoca as part of Sports Festival. The event promotes team spirit and fun, offering a unique sporting experience in the heart of the city. Participants can enjoy a vibrant atmosphere and challenges on routes adapted for all ages and fitness levels.

Part of Sports Festival
Friendly, energizing atmosphere for all ages
additional: The 2025 edition took place at Cluj Arena, and half of the registration fee was donated to the Via Transilvanica project of the Tășuleasa Social Association. Registration details and the fee for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: SPORTS FESTIVAL Alergăm pentru Cluj!
description: Sports Festival is Romania’s largest multisport event, held in Cluj-Napoca from June 11 to 14, 2026. The festival combines sports competitions, introductory activities, demonstrations, concerts, and educational events, offering a unique sports and entertainment experience for all ages. The Superheroes Run, a 5 km and 10 km race, is an important part of the festival, encouraging participants to run for a social cause and support the Via Transilvanica community. The event brings together champions, supporters, and sports enthusiasts in a festive, welcoming setting.

name: Topoloveni Summer Tour ~ 2026
description: Topoloveni Summer Tour is an event for amateur cyclists in Romania, organized by Riders Club. Participants can choose to enjoy an outdoor ride or compete for a place in the national amateur cycling rankings. The route is carefully prepared to protect the natural environment, and course markings will be kept to a minimum to respect the forests and natural areas. The event offers opportunities for all ages, including children’s races and options for families with special discounts. In the event of unfavorable weather conditions, the race may be rescheduled to a backup date.

name: Run for Heroes
description: Run for Heroes is an annual charity race taking place on June 14, 2026, in Herăstrău Park, Bucharest, on Șoseaua Kiseleff. The event brings together runners of all ages, families, and pets to support free psychotherapy services. The courses are accessible and welcoming, with an energetic atmosphere full of fun and solidarity, where every kilometer run contributes to a noble cause. Participants receive themed superhero kits and enjoy a full day of sports and recreational activities.

name: Roșia Montană Marathon
description: Roșia Montană Marathon is a sporting, environmental, and socio-cultural event held in the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană, Alba County. The 13th edition, in 2026, celebrates the area’s nature, history, and cultural heritage, offering a variety of routes for runners of all levels. Races include a marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and children’s race, on courses that combine mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and historic architecture in a setting that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes with elevation changes on mountain trails and local roads
A mix of mountain and road running
Natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage
additional: The event takes place from 19–21 June 2026, with race-kit pickup at Central Square on the day before the race. The programme also includes cultural and social activities, such as creative workshops and concerts. The routes are designed for both mountain and road runners. The event features cultural and environmental activities, community projects, and educational initiatives, offering an opportunity to support the area’s natural and cultural heritage.

name: Maratonul Roșia Montană - Cursa Copiilor ~ 2026
description: The Roșia Montană Marathon is a celebration of nature, history, and cultural heritage, held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană. The varied routes, which include mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections, offer a unique experience for both mountain runners and road runners. The event includes races for all ages, including the Children’s Race, which follows age-group routes in the historic center of the village. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage.

name: Crosul Hoia
description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Run is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, giving participants the opportunity to run along the cool trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes 15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, as well as a race dedicated to families, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. The race takes place in June, swapping urban asphalt for nature and offering an outdoor running experience.

name: Urlea Super Vertical
location: Sat. Breaza, Com. Lisa, Jud. Brașov
description: Urlea Super Vertical is an extreme mountain race set in the wild landscapes of the Făgăraș Mountains, offering a unique vertical running and intense downhill experience. It is Romania’s first and only up-and-down relay, where one partner climbs and the other descends, adding an innovative and spectacular element to the competition. The 12 km course, with an elevation gain of 1,833 m, tests runners’ endurance and technique on forest roads and trails through forests and alpine pastures. The event is for those seeking pure adrenaline and an intense mountain challenge, with a revolutionary awards system that rewards individual and team performance.

name: Maratonul Târnavei
description: The Târnava Marathon is a trail-running event organized by the Târnăveni Cycling Association in collaboration with Ruck Ventilatoare, held in the municipality of Târnăveni, Mureș County. Now in its 10th edition, the marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and running in nature, aiming to increase environmental education and awareness of the benefits of outdoor sports. The start and finish are located on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare, and the competition includes several trail-running courses for all ages and levels. The event brings together a community of athletes passionate about running and respect for the environment.

name: Cros Montan Traversare Igniș
description: Traversare Igniș is a traditional mountain running competition, now in its 17th edition, bringing together runners and mountain lovers from across the region. The event offers two races in an authentic mountain setting, with genuine elevation gain and spectacular scenery. The routes include a 14 km Cross with 1,000 m of positive elevation gain and a Half Marathon of approximately 23 km with 1,450 m of positive elevation gain. Participants receive a race kit, access to hydration points, and medical assistance, and the finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl.

name: Rodnei Sky Race
description: Rodnei Sky Race is a mountain running competition held in the Rodna Mountains, near Borșa, Maramureș. The event offers three distinct routes suited to different experience levels: the Puzdrelor route, the most difficult, for experienced runners; the Gărgălău route, a moderate challenge for well-prepared runners; and the Musceta route, a fast course with a large elevation drop. The race is part of the Carpathians Circuit and emphasizes the experience of running in nature amid spectacular mountain scenery. The organizers invite families and mountain sports enthusiasts to take part in an active weekend outdoors.

name: Sinaia Mountain Run
description: Sinaia Mountain Run by Constantina Diță is a spectacular mountain race starting and finishing in Sinaia Town Hall Square. The routes pass through scenic areas such as Cota 1000 and Cota 1400, giving runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The event is open to both elite runners and mountain-running enthusiasts, with 10K and 21K races. Participants receive a race kit with a bib, timing chip, and medal, and the organizers provide free digital photo galleries.

name: Cluj Running Festival
description: Cluj Running Festival is an international road-running event held in the heart of Cluj, bringing together elite athletes, thousands of amateur runners, and children at the starting line. The festival combines competitive sport with the joy of movement and the city’s energy, offering a flat, fast course ideal for runners of all levels. The event includes races for children, open 5 km and 10 km races, and an elite race featuring top international athletes. Cluj-Napoca, a young and active city, provides the perfect setting for this celebration of running.

name: CROSUL ORASULUI MIOVENI 1485
description: Mioveni City Run is an annual sporting event organized by the Invictus Mioveni Association in partnership with Mioveni City Hall and the city’s Cultural Center. The event brings together runners of all ages, from 3-year-old children to 78-year-old seniors, on varied 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km routes, as well as special races for the little ones. The atmosphere is vibrant, with music, applause, SMURD demonstrations, and artistic performances, offering a day dedicated to health, community, and sporting fun. The run is a celebration of movement and community spirit, supported by major sponsors such as TEMAD, WD-40 Romania, and UHU Romania.

name: Crosul Oraşului Mioveni 1485 - Ed. a - IV - a ~ 2026
description: The Mioveni City Run is a sporting event organized by Invictus Romania, dedicated to promoting a spirit of solidarity and courage, especially among wounded military personnel. The event takes place in the civic center of Mioveni and is part of a series of charitable and commemorative sporting competitions. Participants are encouraged to join in and support the values of honor and respect in a friendly and motivating setting.

name: Carpathia Trails

description: Carpathia Trails is a mountain running race taking place on July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort in Fundata, crossing three mountain ranges: the Bucegi Mountains, the Leaota Mountains, and the Piatra Craiului Mountains. The event offers six individual race options, ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon, suitable for all experience levels. Participants can enjoy spectacular scenery and a unique experience in nature in a friendly, well-organized setting. Registration is limited and available online until June 23, 2026.
course_highlights: Routes crossing three mountain ranges: Bucegi, Leaota, and Piatra Craiului
Distances ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon
Spectacular natural scenery in the Cheile Grădiștei area

The event takes place on July 4, 2026, in Cheile Grădiștei, Fundata, Brașov.

name: Cozia Mountain Run
description: Cozia Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Cozia Massif, on the left bank of the Olt River, in the Călimănești-Căciulata spa resort. The event, organized by the Pegas Triathlon Club Association with the support of local authorities, promotes mountain running, local traditions, and humanitarian fundraising. Participants take on three challenging, unmarked mountain routes that require experience and mountain skills. The atmosphere is friendly and energizing, and after the race all runners are invited to lunch at Turnu Monastery.

name: Legendele Nemirei
description: Legends of Nemira is a mountain running race held in Slănic Moldova, offering spectacular routes through cool forests and along the ridges of the Nemira Massif. Participants enjoy a well-marked course with wild natural scenery and alpine challenges, suitable for experienced runners. The event is appreciated for its careful organization, dedicated volunteers, and friendly atmosphere, making it a memorable experience for mountain running enthusiasts.

name: Zalău Ultra Trail
description: Zalău Ultra Trail is a mountain running competition held over three days in the heart of the Sălaj Mountains. The event offers a variety of races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, including a 103 km ultra race with over 5,000 m of elevation gain. ZUT is more than a competition: it is a platform that brings together athletes, the local community, and nature, promoting a spirit of adventure and respect for the environment. The routes are challenging and spectacular, offering an authentic trail-running experience amid impressive natural landscapes.
course_highlights: 103 km ULTRA course with 5,255 m of elevation gain
Well-equipped aid and checkpoint stations along the route
A variety of races, from a 2.5 km children’s race to a 103 km ultra
additional: The event takes place over 3 days, with multiple races suited to different levels of fitness. The Last Man Standing race is a special endurance competition with 6.7 km laps every hour, eliminating participants who do not finish in time. There are prize categories for children and Cross races. Mandatory equipment is specified in the regulations, and aid stations provide water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and hot food along the ultra course. Multiple race distances, including races for children and charity events; an emphasis on promoting local values and community spirit; the event also includes an environmental awareness component.

name: Stâna de Vale Trail Race
description: Stâna de Vale Trail Race is a mountain running competition held amid the spectacular scenery of the Carpathian Mountains, at the Stâna de Vale resort in Bihor County. The event is part of the EMA Off-Road Running 2026 circuit and offers races for all levels, from beginner routes to demanding mountain ultramarathons. Participants can enjoy well-marked routes, full support along the course, and a friendly post-race atmosphere. The race weekend also includes an 8 km vertical race, a classic 11 km race, and a long 33 km race with significant elevation gain.
course_highlights: A 33 km mountain route with 1,500 m of positive elevation gain, featuring technical sections and panoramic views
An 11 km route suited to beginners and intermediate runners, through forests and gentle hills
An 8 km vertical race with 1,100 m of elevation gain, featuring a continuous, demanding climb
additional: The event takes place on 10–11 July 2026, with race-pack collection at Hotel Iadolina, Stâna de Vale. The Vertical 8K starts on Friday at 10:00, while the 33 km and 11 km races start on Saturday at 08:30 and 09:30. The organizers provide a post-race meal and a party after the awards ceremony. Participation in the EMA circuit requires a valid license for the 35–79 age category. The routes are on mountain terrain, and the event includes timing. Participants can choose between two distances to suit their fitness level.

name: Predeal Forest Run
description: Predeal Forest Run is a mountain running event held in Predeal, Brașov, on July 11, 2026. The event offers five trail-running routes suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 13 km to 38 km. The routes pass through forests, mountain trails, and areas with spectacular scenery, offering a complete mountain-running experience. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and active running community, making it an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the Piatra Mare Mountains.
course_highlights: 100% trail-running routes through forests and along mountain trails
Challenging climbs, including more than 500 m of elevation gain over 4 km on K24
Spectacular scenery at Poiana Stanei Pietricica, Vf. Piatra Mare, and Cabana Garbova
additional: The event includes five races: K13 Cros, K24 Semimaraton, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Maraton, and Family Run (non-competitive). The start is at the base of the Clăbucet ski slopes. The routes are marked with yellow tape bearing the red Predeal Forest Run logo and are supported by volunteers. Cut-off times and aid stations are set for the competitive races. The race kit will be announced later. Participants can register in various race categories, and the event promotes a social cause. Registration details and rules are available on the official website.

The courses pass through spectacular scenery, including Cabana Dochia, Vf. Lespezi, and Vf. Toaca, offering runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The organizers provide a friendly atmosphere and good logistics for participants.

name: BUILA TRAIL RACE Discover Oltenia de sub munte!

Participants can choose from children’s races, cross-country races, and mountain trails of 11, 18, and 36 km, all featuring spectacular scenery and authentic mountain challenges.

Participation supports the Țara Colibelor project through a donation included in the entry fee, and after the race runners are invited to a brunch featuring local products. The event promotes ecotourism and the preservation of the mountain cultural heritage of the Cindrel and Lotrului Mountains.

name: Bucovina Ultra Rocks
description: Bucovina Ultra Rocks by UTMB invites you to explore the wild heart of the Eastern Carpathians, one of Europe’s last authentic wilderness areas. With six races ranging from a fast 15 km run to a 114 km challenge, the routes cross rocky ridges, UNESCO-protected old-growth forests, medieval sheepfolds, and impressive natural landscapes such as Moara Dracului Gorge and Pietrele Doamnei. Expect steep climbs, technical trails, and authentic mountain conditions, with every kilometre offering a unique experience in the European wilderness.

name: SEMIMARATON TARA DE PIATRĂ
description: The Țara de Piatră Half Marathon is a running race taking place on 26 July 2026 in the Avram Iancu area, Câmpeni, Alba, Romania. Participants can choose from three races of different distances, running routes through the Apuseni Mountains’ historic and natural landscapes, imbued with the spirit of their ancestors. The start is scheduled for 8:00, and transport to the start line is provided by coach. Race kits can be collected on Saturday and on Sunday morning before the start. The event offers an authentic, energizing experience for runners of all levels.

name: LATERAL Mures 24H ~ 2026
description: Lateral Mures 24H is an endurance sports event organized by the Mureș Runners Association, held in the heart of nature on the Cornești Plateau in Târgu Mureș. The competition includes 24-hour MTB and trail-running events, both individual and team, as well as a 12-hour running race and a one-lap 10.5 km race. The course is an approximately 10.5 km loop with 215 m of elevation gain, mostly through forest, clearly marked during the day and with reflective signs at night. The event promotes team spirit, endurance, and a passion for exercising in nature.

name: Tura Licuricilor ~ 2026
description: The 11th edition of Tura Licuricilor is a running event held in Franz Joseph Park in Timișoara on August 1, 2026, starting at 20:30. The event is part of the Alergotura series, which promotes running as a lifestyle and supports the local sports community. Participants can enjoy a pleasant outdoor race in an urban natural setting, suitable for runners of all levels. The organizers provide support and motivation to encourage people to take up running and get involved in the community.

name: Mogoșa Everesting
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv de Alergare Montană Maramureș
description: Mogoșa Everesting is a mountain running competition taking place on August 1, 2026, at Lake Mogoșa, Maramureș, Romania. Participants can compete individually or in teams, completing laps on the mountain course to reach a total elevation gain equivalent to Everest. The event is organized by the Maramureș Mountain Running Sports Club Association and offers a challenging, community-oriented experience, with categories for juniors and teams. Entry fees are affordable, and registration is open until places are filled.

name: Retezat Mountain Run ~ 2026
description: Retezat Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat Mountains, with routes climbing to the summit of Mount Retezat. The event offers four races of varying difficulty and distance, from the 8.5 km Easy Run to a nearly 40 km Marathon with over 3,300 m of elevation gain. The routes cross wild landscapes, with aid stations in hard-to-reach areas, and the event is organized with the help of dedicated volunteers and mountain authorities. The event continues the tradition of the Retezat Marathon, with a new team and a long-term plan for continuity.

name: ALERG ÎN DUMBRAVĂ
description: Alerg în Dumbravă is a social, sporting, and charitable event that promotes outdoor running and a healthy lifestyle. It takes place in Homu Forest, north of the village of Glogoveanu, Dâmbovița County. The event features marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country races dedicated to the memory of local personalities, offering an outdoor experience on accessible trails and dirt roads. Recreational activities such as Latin dancing and a campfire add to the welcoming community atmosphere. Now in its seventh edition, the long-running event also supports an important social cause by helping Mia’s Children Association.

name: Maratonul Nordului Teioasa Trail
description: The Maratonul Nordului Teioasa Trail is a trail-running race held in northern Romania, offering participants an authentic experience amid spectacular scenery. The event promotes health, community, and adventure, bringing together passionate runners in a remarkable natural setting. The routes are designed to showcase the beauty of the area and the spirit of northern Romania.

name: Ultra Race Romania
description: Ultra Race Romania is a unique long-distance running race covering 250 km over 6 stages, in a self-sufficient format, exploring the unspoiled wilderness, culture, and history of the Siriu area in Buzău. Participants will tackle a challenging route through the Carpathian Mountains, with legendary scenery and places steeped in local stories and mysteries. After the race, runners are invited to stay for two days to discover Romania’s traditions, cuisine, and famous tourist attractions, such as Peleș Castle and Bran Castle. The event focuses on the experience of a lifetime, lasting friendships, and the joy of being part of this extraordinary adventure.

name: THE COLOR RUN - MAMAIA BY NIGHT
description: The Color Run - Mamaia by Night is a colorful, energetic 5-kilometer race along a route in Mamaia, near the large parking area in front of the Rex Hotel. The event celebrates health, joy, and originality. Participants are showered with fluorescent powder at every kilometer, and the fun continues with a cloud of colored powder at the finish. The race is untimed, focusing on a joyful experience and a festival atmosphere with music and interactive activities. Suitable for all ages, including young children, it promises a memorable evening of running and outdoor fun.

name: GLS NIGHT CROS CHALLENGE Start la muzeul în aer liber din Dumbrava Sibiului
description: GLS Night Cross Challenge is a night running race with a 10-year tradition in Sibiu, held in Dumbrava Sibiului. The event offers a unique outdoor running experience on specially prepared trails, surrounded by nature, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. Participants can enjoy a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, ideal for amateurs and athletes of all levels. The organizers emphasize pushing personal limits and the joy of running together as a community.

name: GLS Night Cross Challenge ~ 2026
description: Night Cross Challenge powered by GLS is Romania’s most beautiful night cross-country race, reaching its 12th edition in 2026. The event takes place at the Dumbrava Sibiului Open-Air Museum, offering participants a unique running experience on marked routes after dark. Races are available for adults over distances of 4.5 km and 9 km, as well as children over distances of 500 m, 1,000 m, and 1,300 m. The competition is open to all age groups from 5 to 75 years, with prizes for the winners of the open category in the 9 km race.

name: 2X2 Race
location: Lacul Bâlea, Transfăgărășan, Sibiu County, Romania
description: 2X2 Race is an extremely technical and challenging mountain ultramarathon, held entirely above 2,000 m in the Făgăraș Mountains, Romania. The main 45 km course, with 4,200 m of elevation gain, passes over Romania’s two highest peaks, Moldoveanu and Negoiu. Two other races, X1 Race (26 km, 2,400 m elevation gain) and X2 Race (18 km, 1,900 m elevation gain), are also highly technical and intense, and intended for runners with mountain experience. Participation is limited and subject to experience requirements to ensure competitors’ safety given the high physical and mental demands.

name: Via Transilvanica Maraton
description: Via Transilvanica Marathon 2026 is a sporting event that celebrates Romania’s nature and unique heritage, held along the Via Transilvanica route. The marathon offers a challenge of 39.3 km with an elevation gain of 1,292 m, crossing forest roads, villages, and panoramic landscapes. Participants enjoy a friendly atmosphere, with well-organized checkpoints and hydration stations, as well as activities for children. The event is organized by the Țășuleasa Social Association, which promotes volunteering and respect for nature.

name: CROS DONATON
location: Muzeul Etnografic al Transilvaniei, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania

name: Underdogs
description: Underdogs - The Backyard Ultra is a unique endurance race set in the beautiful landscape of Brebu, Dâmbovița County, Romania. Participants run repeated 6.8 km loops, with a start every hour, until only one competitor remains in the race. This competition tests runners’ physical and mental limits, offering an intense, community-focused experience where every step is a challenge and a story of resilience. Founded on Lazarus Lake’s concept, the race brings together ultra-running enthusiasts in an adventurous setting built on mutual support.

name: OSLEA RUN
description: Oslea Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, in the area of the Oslea, Paltina, and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs. Organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului, the event continues the local tradition of mountain running, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular trails in the heart of nature, at the meeting point of Retezat and Domogled–Valea Cernei National Parks. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with challenging routes and impressive scenery. The event also includes a children’s race, as well as related social and cultural activities.

name: Oslea Run ~ 2026
description: Oslea Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, around the Oslea, Paltina, and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs, organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului. The event continues the area's tradition of mountain running, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular routes amid nature, where Retezat and Domogled-Valea Cernei National Parks meet. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with prizes, race kits, and related activities such as tastings and socializing.

name: Aventura în Vrancea Sălbatică
location: Putna-Vrancea Natural Park, Vrancea County, Romania

name: Vrancea Montană Run
description: Vrancea Montană Run is a mountain running event held in the Vrancea Mountains, in the commune of Păulești, offering an authentic experience in nature for runners of all levels. The race features two main events: an 11 km cross-country race with approximately 350 m of elevation gain and a 21 km half marathon with 550 m of elevation gain. Both take place on varied, unpaved routes combining forest roads, trails, and rugged terrain. The event is organized by the Vrancea Montană Association with support from Păulești City Hall, and promotes respect for the wilderness and fair play among competitors. Participants also contribute to a worthy cause by supporting wildlife rehabilitation in Romania.

name: Maratonul Olteniei
description: Maratonul Olteniei is a multi-sport event featuring running, MTB, and Hyathlon Sprint, held in Zăvoi Park in Râmnicu Vâlcea. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of being together, emphasizing the connections between participants and their shared motivation. It is a celebration of sport and nature, with a strong tradition and a dedicated community. Participants enjoy varied courses and a friendly atmosphere that encourages performance and socializing.

name: Șopa Forest Race ~ 2027
location: Șopa Forest, Șelimbăr, Sibiu County, Romania

name: CugiRace
location: Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, Jud. Alba
description: CugiRace is a mountain running competition held in Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, offering events for all fitness levels: an ultramarathon, half marathon, 10 km cross-country race, and children’s race. The courses are varied, with significant elevation changes, offering a challenging and scenic experience in the Cugir Mountains. The event promotes outdoor exercise and a healthy lifestyle, welcoming both experienced runners and those looking to make the transition to ultramarathons. The atmosphere is friendly, supported by careful organization and dedicated volunteers.

name: StruguRUN
description: StruguRUN is a unique running competition set among the vineyards and historic scenery of Odobești, Vrancea. The event offers three races for all levels: the Half Marathon, the Cross-Country Race, and the Popular Race, each following spectacular routes through vineyards and forests and along the Milcov River. Participants can enjoy an authentic experience that combines sport with nature and local traditions in a friendly, energizing atmosphere.

name: Sighișoara 10K
organizer: Asociația Părinților din „Clubul Sportiv Școlar” Sighișoara
description: Sighișoara 10K is a running race offering a unique experience through the heart of the medieval citadel of Sighișoara, combining sport with the discovery of the city’s historical treasures. The event includes 10K and 5K races, a children’s race, and an Up Stairs challenge, and is open to all age groups and fitness levels. Participants can enjoy a vibrant, energetic course, with cash prizes and a raffle for all runners. The race is held in memory of Dr. Stelian Larga, a cardiologist and citizen actively involved in the city’s sporting and cultural life.

name: CIUCAȘ X3 Scriem povestea. Împreună clădim tradiție.
organizer: Clubul de Turism și Alpinism Ciucaș Ploiești
description: Ciucaș X3 is a mountain running event organized by the Ciucaș Ploiești Tourism and Mountaineering Club, promoting outdoor activity and mountain sports. A range of races, from a short vertical race to an ultramarathon, take place in the Ciucaș Mountains, offering challenges for amateurs, professionals, and children. The event has a history spanning more than 16 editions and supports the sustainable development of the local community. Participants can experience spectacular mountain scenery and varied routes in a friendly atmosphere with professional organization.

name: European Masters Off Road Championships
description: The 2026 European Masters Off-Road Running Championships in Râșnov bring together masters athletes from across Europe to compete in the heart of the Carpathian Mountains. The event takes place in the historic town of Râșnov, offering a technical trail-running course combined with Transylvania’s rich cultural heritage. This competition is a unique opportunity for masters athletes to test their skills on challenging and scenic terrain.

name: Woodrocks Trail Run
description: Woodrocks Trail Run is a mountain running event held in the village of Petriș, offering three storybook courses for runners of all levels. The 6 km Green Course is ideal for beginners, with shady trails and gentle hills. The 15 km Blue Course offers an exhilarating experience with moderate climbs, while the 35 km Pink Course is a thrilling adventure with 1,600 metres of elevation gain over rugged terrain and scenic ridgelines. The event celebrates the joy of running in nature and supports environmental education through the EcoStuff Romania Association.

name: Maratonul Dragomirnei
description: The Dragomirna Marathon is an annual competition held in the Dragomirna Beech Forest Nature Reserve in Suceava. It offers a unique running experience in nature, combining scenic landscapes with a friendly atmosphere and professional organization. The event includes several races, from a full marathon to a half marathon and a cross-country race, catering to both experienced and amateur runners. Participants receive race kits and prizes, while the organizers promote an active community committed to supporting sport and the environment.

name: AIUD GREEN RUN by DP World
organizer: DP World, Primăria și Consiliul Local Aiud, Asociația Dr. Brendus Gyula Egyesület
description: Aiud Green Run by DP World is a sporting event that promotes a healthy, eco-friendly lifestyle, giving participants the opportunity to run scenic routes surrounded by nature and authentic Transylvanian landscapes. The event includes a 21 km half marathon, an 8 km race, and a 2 km family run, suitable for all experience levels. The routes are designed to challenge and inspire runners while offering a friendly atmosphere and a memorable experience in the municipality of Aiud. The start is near Aiud Fortress, and the event is organized in partnership with Aiud City Hall and the Dr. Brendus Gyula Egyesulet Association.

name: Râșnov Medieval Run  ~ 2026
location: centrul orașului Râșnov, Râșnov, Brașov County, Romania
description: Râșnov Medieval Run is a running race held in the center of Râșnov, combining medieval spirit with a passion for running. The event offers participants a unique experience, with clear participation requirements, including presenting a medical certificate and wearing the race bib throughout the race. The start is scheduled for the morning, and the organizers provide facilities such as timing, first aid, and a dedicated start and finish area. It is a competition suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a special atmosphere and the picturesque scenery of Râșnov.
