Registration is online, with on-site registration also possible while places remain.

name: Rombat Trail Run
description: Rombat Trail Run is a mountain running race that invites over 600 nature lovers to take part in the spectacular natural landscape of the Ghinzii and Codrișor forests. The event offers an authentic trail-running experience, combining athletic challenge with the beauty of the surrounding environment. Organized by Runners Club, this competition is for running enthusiasts who want to enjoy nature and test their limits in a friendly, professional setting.

name: Zăvoi Trail Comana
description: Zăvoi Trail Comana is a sporting event for trail running and mountain biking enthusiasts, held in the heart of Comana Natural Park, a protected area with impressive biodiversity. The event takes place on September 12–13, 2026, and is organized by the Plogging for Romania Association, which promotes sport and environmental protection through plogging activities. The routes offer an authentic nature-exploration experience, combining athletic challenge with awareness of the importance of protecting the local ecosystem. Participants can choose between mountain bike and trail running races, each featuring spectacular and accessible routes.

name: Baia Mare Half Marathon
organizer: Maramureș Runners, Rotary Club Baia Mare
description: The Baia Mare Half Marathon is an annual sporting event that brings together runners from across the country to celebrate movement, community, and an active lifestyle. The main race is the 21 km half marathon, held on an urban course consisting of 6 loops of 3.5 km each, for participants over the age of 15. The event also includes relay races, a 7 km cross-country race, a 3 km fun run, children’s races, and a special AutiSmile race dedicated to people with autism. The organizers emphasize health, community, and environmental protection, planting trees for every kilometer run.

name: Șiria Vertical Loop
description: Șiria Vertical Loop 2h is a short-duration mountain running competition for both amateurs and professionals, promoting the tourist heritage of Arad County, especially Șiria Fortress. The race follows a vertical-race course, with a 2.5 km loop and approximately 240 m of elevation gain per loop. The race lasts 2 hours. Participants must complete at least one full loop to be considered finishers. The race is known for its difficulty and the mental challenge it involves. The event is part of the A.T.I.A. Trail Trilogy and is included in the ITRA National League.

name: Gușterița Trail Run
description: Gușterița Trail Run (GTR) is a mountain running race held in Gușterița Forest in Sibiu, offering accessible and varied routes for runners of all levels, from beginners to professionals. The routes cross a rich natural area, with dirt trails and spruce forests, offering an authentic trail-running experience close to the city. The event promotes both competition and community, bringing together mountain running enthusiasts in a spectacular natural setting. GTR is an ideal opportunity to push your limits and enjoy nature in the company of other runners.

name: Mogoșa Race
description: Mogoșa Race is an annual mountain running competition held in September, starting at Domeniul Mogoșa in Baia Sprie, Maramureș. The event offers a variety of courses, from 4 km for all participants, to an accessible and engaging 11 km route, and a 21 km half marathon for experienced runners, featuring demanding climbs and technical descents. The race promotes an active lifestyle and the discovery of the natural beauty of the Mogoșa area in a vibrant, community atmosphere. It is organized by the Baia Mare în Mișcare Association, which supports physical activity and health in the community.

name: OMU MARATHON by Transilvania 100
description: OMU Marathon by Transilvania 100 is a challenging mountain race held in the Bucegi Mountains, finishing at the iconic Bran Castle. The main marathon covers 41 km with nearly 3,000 meters of elevation gain, traversing windswept plateaus, dark forests, and ancient trails up to Vf Omu at 2,505 meters. The event also features two shorter races, SCARA Skyrace (24 km, 1,800 m climb) and POARTA Cross (11 km, 420 m climb), all offering breathtaking Transylvanian scenery and professional support from the experienced Transylvania 100 team. The race takes place in early October, promising a memorable late-summer mountain adventure.

name: Oradea City Running Day
description: Oradea City Running Day is an annual sporting event held in Oradea, offering running races for all ages and fitness levels. The courses include a half marathon, a corporate relay, a 10.5 km race, and a popular 5 km run, all held on an urban route marked with blue arrows that passes through notable areas of the city. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and team spirit, especially through the relay race dedicated to company employees. Participants receive race kits with an electronic chip and have access to refreshment points along the route.

name: Crosul Companiilor
description: The Crosul Companiilor powered by Emerson is the largest team-building event in Cluj-Napoca, bringing together employees from various companies for a race through the city streets. The event promotes team spirit and health through sport, offering participants an enjoyable and dynamic experience. The course is designed to be accessible and motivating, encouraging people to take part in teams and support their colleagues. The organizers, Runners Club, provide a friendly and professional atmosphere, with official partners and dedicated support.

name: Semimaraton Brăila
description: The Brăila Half Marathon is an annual race held along the riverfront and in Monument Park in Brăila, offering participants an enjoyable and accessible running experience. The event promotes solidarity by supporting local charitable causes, and runners can turn every kilometer into an act of support for the community. The course is suitable for both amateur and experienced runners, providing an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of Brăila in a friendly, sporty setting.

name: CURSA IMPOSIBILĂ
description: The Impossible Race is a unique virtual event in which participants reach the finish line one hour before the time they started. It is not a competitive race, but a personal and collective challenge held throughout 2026. Participants can choose from multiple sports and routes, including running, walking, cycling, rollerblading, swimming, and water sports, with a range of distances, some even thousands of kilometers long. The event emphasizes community spirit and supporting causes, and awards a finisher medal to everyone who completes the challenge.

name: Semimaraton Porolissum
organizer: ASOCIATIA CLUBUL SPORTIV TODO RUN ZALĂU
description: Porolissum Half Marathon is an annual mountain race held in the heart of history, in the area around the Porolissum Roman Camp in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The event offers three distinct races: the 23 km Half Marathon, the 12 km Salamander Race, and the 1.6 km Fortifications Tour, welcoming runners of all levels. The routes combine the challenge of mountain running with spectacular scenery and historical features, making them ideal for nature and history enthusiasts. The organizers provide a complete experience, with hydration stations, timing, and an awards ceremony.

name: ASCOTID Trail Race
organizer: ASCOTID (Asociația Copiilor și Tinerilor Diabetici - Mureș)
description: ASCOTID Trail Race is an annual off-road running competition held in the Cornești Plateau area of Târgu Mureș. The event promotes physical activity for all age groups and was initiated by the Association of Children and Young People with Diabetes Mureș (ASCOTID). The routes include a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as races for children and families, offering an accessible yet challenging experience due to the elevation changes. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere, with a focus on social and health goals.

name: „Alerg Pentru Tine” Trail Run
description: Alerg Pentru Tine Trail Run is a charity sporting event held in the picturesque forests of Bucovina, near Sucevița. The event supports palliative care patients at Sf. Luca Sucevița and Sf. Mc. Zenovie Dr. Suceava hospitals, bringing joy and fulfilling the dreams of those going through difficult times. Participants can choose from three moderately difficult races, suitable for both experienced and less experienced runners, and are encouraged to run with heart and determination for a noble cause. The courses offer spectacular views of the Sucevița Valley and the local monastery, and the atmosphere is one of solidarity and community support.

name: ALBA IULIA CITY RACE Aleargă în cealaltă capitală!
description: Alba Iulia City Race is a major athletic event held in the heart of the Alba Carolina Citadel, giving participants the opportunity to run through a remarkable historic setting. The competition includes several races, from a half marathon and a 10 km cross-country race to fun runs and children’s races, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a community of runners. The event is a running festival, combining a passion for sport with exploration and recognition of local values. The organizers emphasize a complete experience, with personalized race kits, hydration stations, electronic timing, and attractive prizes.

name: POROLISSUM TRAIL
description: Porolissum Half Marathon is a mountain running event taking place on September 26, 2026, in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The main 23 km course offers a spectacular experience, starting and finishing at the heart of history, the Porolissum Roman Fort. The event also includes 12 km and 1.6 km races, catering to both advanced runners and enthusiasts of nature and history. The organizers offer a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, with race-kit pickup available in the days leading up to the event and on race day.

name: TRASCĂU TRAIL RUN
description: Trascău Trail Run is a mountain race offering three events: marathon, half marathon, and cross-country, set amid the scenic landscapes around Rimetea, Alba. Participants will explore the natural beauty of the Trascău Mountains on routes featuring challenging climbs, forests, gorges, and spectacular viewpoints. The event focuses on the experience of running in nature, with courses that combine physical challenge, storybook scenery, and local heritage. The organizers provide hydration and aid stations, medals for those who finish within the time limit, and prizes for the top competitors.

name: Crosul Arenelor
description: Crosul Arenelor is a unique running event in Bucharest, taking place on a 10-kilometer course between two iconic arenas: the Arcul de Triumf National Stadium and the National Arena. The race runs in one direction, with no turnarounds, along the capital’s most beautiful streets, offering a fast and smooth experience. The event also includes a 2 km Family Run and a wheelchair race, and is open to all running enthusiasts. The organizers focus on creating an energizing atmosphere, with cheer points along the course and a complete race kit for runners.

name: Buzău 21k
description: Buzău 21k is the first half marathon in Buzău County, organized by the Buzău Community Foundation and taking place on September 27, 2026. The event brings the local community together to promote exercise, health, and charity, offering a vibrant running experience in the heart of the city. The course starts at Buzău Athletics Stadium, crosses Crâng Park, and continues along the city’s main boulevards and streets, creating an atmosphere full of energy and joy. Buzău 21k is more than a sporting competition—it is a call to action for movement and community involvement.

The event offers courses suitable for all ages, including races for children and adults, over distances of 3 km and 6 km. The courses are designed to be accessible and enjoyable, following the park’s paths and offering a recreational and competitive outdoor experience. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and facilities dedicated to runners.

description: Queen Maria Cross is a running event held in Cluj-Napoca, bringing together the local running community for a competition full of energy and sportsmanship. The course starts near the Horia Demian Sports Hall and offers participants an enjoyable experience in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere. The event is supported by official sponsors and partners, helping ensure smooth operations and amenities for runners. It is an excellent opportunity for athletes of all levels to enjoy running outdoors and connect with other enthusiasts.

name: Last Man Standing
description: Last Man Standing is a unique endurance and strategy race in which each 6.7 km lap must be completed within one hour. Participants start every hour on the hour, and anyone who fails to finish in time or drops out is eliminated. The race continues until only one runner remains, testing the physical and mental limits of the competitors. The event is part of Zalău Ultra Trail, a platform that brings together sport, community, and nature.

name: Veverița Night Run
description: Veverița Night Run is a nighttime mountain-running race in Bucovina, held in the town of Vatra Dornei. The event offers two moderately difficult races, 12 km and 22 km, on routes consisting mainly of mountain trails, with sections through forest and open meadows. The start and finish are at the base of the Veverița ski slope, and the route reaches Diecilor Peak at an altitude of 1,301 meters. Participants should be prepared for nighttime mountain running and bring appropriate gear, including a headlamp and a mobile phone.

name: Harvest Run
description: Harvest Run is a community sports event that promotes a healthy lifestyle through running and is open to all ages and fitness levels. The event takes place in Vladimirescu, Arad, and includes races for children, families, and amateur or experienced runners. Each edition supports social causes, turning running into an act of solidarity and support for the community. Participants enjoy a friendly, inclusive atmosphere, with courses adapted for all ages and performance levels.

name: Brașov Running Festival
distance_verbose: 12 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 metri, 1.2 km, 0.8 km
description: Brașov Running Festival is a top road-running event that brings thousands of runners to Brașov, from amateurs to elite athletes, in an atmosphere full of energy, music, and fun. The festival includes a variety of races, from a 5 km race for beginners and races for children to tRUNsylvania 10K, the only road race in Romania certified with a World Athletics Elite Label. The event takes place on the streets of Brașov’s Tractorul district and offers a complete experience with cheering zones, live performances, and TV broadcasts. It is a celebration of running that combines athletic performance with the joy of community.

name: MARZESTI TRAIL RUN ALEARGĂ, FII PARTE DIN NATURĂ!
description: Mârzeşti Trail Run is an annual cross-country running competition held in the Breazu area, in Rediu commune, Iași County, with the start and finish in front of the forestry ranger station in Mârzeşti Forest. The varied courses include wooded areas, meadows, forest roads and agricultural roads, offering a unique running experience in nature, with flat sections, descents and climbs. The event promotes outdoor sports and supports local social causes, providing an opportunity for running enthusiasts to enjoy themselves and meet. The half-marathon distance and the other races are suitable for different levels of training, and the event includes hydration points and course marshals.

name: UVT Liberty Marathon
description: UVT Liberty Marathon is a running competition held in Timișoara that promotes a healthy lifestyle and the freedom to discover yourself through movement. The event offers races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 200 meters to a full 42 km marathon. The UVT Liberty Marathon community is dedicated to supporting and motivating participants to reach their potential and enjoy running in a friendly, energetic setting. The courses are designed to challenge and inspire, and the atmosphere is supportive and free-spirited.

name: Hercules Maraton
description: Hercules Marathon is a mountain running event organized in the Cerna Valley, Băile Herculane, by Alternative Timișoara Sports Club. The competition includes Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) races on mountain trails that cross the Cerna Mountains and connect the area’s 39 hamlets. It is one of the first mountain marathons in the region, offering an authentic trail-running experience amid spectacular natural scenery. The event is for runners who are passionate about mountain terrain and adventure.

The event is known for its vibrant atmosphere, community support, and involvement in charitable causes. Participants can experience an urban course that passes major landmarks in the capital, with hydration and support stations along the way.

description: Azuga Trail Race powered by JYSK is an annual mountain running event held in the town of Azuga and the Baiului Mountains, Romania. The event offers passionate runners a unique experience across four spectacular routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains. Participants can enjoy nature, physical and mental challenges, and an atmosphere filled with adrenaline and competitive spirit. It is an opportunity to test your limits and meet people who share your passions.
course_highlights: Four mountain routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains
Routes in the Baiului Mountains, with aid stations offering water, energy drinks, and fruit
Different start locations for the main races and children’s races, including special routes with gondola transport
additional: The race kit includes a personalized bib, personalized products, individual chip timing, aid stations with water and fruit, finisher medals, cash and sports equipment prizes, surprise prize draws, ITRA/UTMB points where applicable, and an official photo and video album. Gondola transport is included for the Family Walk & Run and Urechea Run. Awards ceremony at 17:00, SuperParty on Saturday evening with DJ Cătălin Sănătescu. Routes with significant elevation gain, impressive mountain scenery, a festive atmosphere, and activities for the whole family.

description: Făget Tour GlobalLogic is a running race organized by Runners Club in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run in nature during one of the most beautiful times of the year. The event includes two main races: a 7 km cross-country race and a 22 km half marathon, held on scenic routes in the Făget area. This competition is a cherished tradition among the local running community, now in its 15th edition, and promises an enjoyable and challenging experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 7 km cross-country route in nature
22 km half marathon with scenic views
Routes marked and supported by Runners Club Cluj-Napoca
additional: The routes are marked, and a GPX file is available for the half marathon. The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. The race has official partners and supporters. The event also includes other trail races and related activities, offering an opportunity to discover the area's natural beauty and take part in a community sporting event.

name: ALERGAREA DE SAMBATA - CALARASI
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv Alergarea de Sâmbătă
description: The “Saturday Run” Half Marathon in Călărași is a landmark sporting event for the local community, bringing amateur and professional runners together for a friendly, motivating competition. The course takes place in Central Park, offering an enjoyable and accessible experience for all participants. The atmosphere is supportive and full of camaraderie, with facilities to ensure runners’ comfort, including tents for relaxation and first aid. The event promotes personal progress and sportsmanship, making it an excellent opportunity to socialize and test your endurance.

name: SEMIMARATONUL CRAIOVEI
description: The Craiova Half Marathon is a community-focused fundraising running event organized by the Romanian Association of Young People with Initiative (A.R.T.I.) in collaboration with SightRunning.ro. The event offers timed races for professional runners over distances of 21 km, 14 km, and 7 km, as well as untimed races and activities for all ages and categories, including wheelchair users and pets. The urban course starts and finishes at the Esplanade of Ion Oblemenco Stadium and consists of 7 km loops, with an elevation gain of 58 m. Participation supports charitable projects in education, health, and social inclusion, making the event an opportunity for solidarity and community engagement.

name: TIMIȘOARA CITY MARATHON
description: Timișoara City Marathon is a sporting event for both amateurs and experienced runners, held in the heart of Timișoara. The 42.2 km marathon starts in Otelec and finishes in Victory Square, offering a unique experience inspired by the story of Eugeniu of Savoy’s arrival. The half marathon and fun runs offer varied routes through the city’s squares, parks, and historic neighborhoods, showcasing local beauty and heritage. The event also includes related activities such as workshops, a Pasta Party, and the special anniversary race “106 pentru POLI”.
course_highlights: The marathon starts outside the city, in Otelec, and finishes in Victory Square
The half marathon combines the squares and parks of the Fabric district along the banks of the Bega
The fun runs pass through the parks along the Bega Canal and the Fabric district
additional: Race packs are distributed at the UPT Rectorate in Victory Square. Marathon participants depart by coach for Otelec at 06:30 from Victory Square. Energy products (bar + gel) are included only for the 42 km and 21 km races. The technical T-shirt and cotton T-shirt can be purchased during registration. The event includes workshops, a Pasta Party, and the anniversary race “106 pentru POLI” on October 29, 2026, at Stadionul Știința. Participants can choose from several race categories, including workshops and a pasta party.

name: Beiuș Running Day
price_range: 10 km: 120 RON, Half Marathon: 150 RON, 2 km și cursa pentru copii: gratuit
description: Beiuș Running Day is an annual running event offering four races for all ages and experience levels, including free races for children and beginners. The routes include a 2 km race, a children’s race, a 10 km race, and a 21.1 km half marathon, on forest trails and paved streets in Beiuș, Bihor. The event emphasizes safety, an eco-friendly environment, and a competitive atmosphere, with podium prizes and surprises for participants. It’s a great opportunity for families and runners of all levels to enjoy sport and nature in an organized, welcoming setting.
course_highlights: Forest trails with natural paths for the 10 km race and half marathon
Children’s race on fully safe paved routes closed to vehicle traffic
Hydration stations and safety measures on all routes
additional: The children’s race is free and open to children aged 4 to 13, with age categories and distances ranging from 250m to 1000m, on fully safe routes closed to vehicle traffic. A parent or guardian must be present with participating children throughout the race. Medals, certificates, and product prizes are awarded to all participants, and the adult routes include hydration stations and are clearly marked. Registration deadline: October 26, 2025; event date: October 31, 2026; varied routes, including urban areas and parks; the event promotes health and physical activity in the community.

name: Hațeg Royal Trail
description: Hațeg Royal Trail is a mountain race held in the picturesque landscape of Hațeg, Hunedoara, offering varied courses for runners of all levels. The event includes a marathon, half marathon, 12 km cross-country race, 6 km race, children’s race, Family Run, and a race for people with special abilities, “I CAN TOO!” The courses pass through forests, hills, and historic sites such as the Royal Hațeg Fortress, offering a technical and spectacular experience. The event is praised for its clear course markings and friendly atmosphere, with attractive prizes and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Courses through forests and hills, with technical climbs and descents
Passage by the Royal Hațeg Fortress, an iconic historic site
Varied scenery including Lunca de Jos, Tronul Străbunilor, and the village of Covragiu
additional: Race kits can be collected between 18:00 and 20:00 on the day before the race. The 6 km cross-country race, 12 km cross-country race, and half marathon start at 10:00, while the Family Run and “I CAN TOO!” races start at 15:00. Registration for the children’s races and Family Run is also available on site, subject to availability. Due to manufacturing tolerances, runners are advised to choose a T-shirt size smaller than their usual size. The event offers cash prizes and gifts, totaling approximately 30,000 RON in 2025, and promotes ecotourism and outdoor activities in the Hațeg Country area.

name: RUN IASI
description: Run Iași is a running event that brings together students, teachers, and residents of the city of Iași to celebrate movement, education, and civic spirit. The race is a declaration of belonging and solidarity, turning every kilometer into a symbol of an active, healthy community. Participants enjoy an energetic, unifying sporting experience in a vibrant urban setting.
course_highlights: An urban route through the city of Iași
A 10 km race for runners of all levels
A community atmosphere and civic spirit
additional: The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, with online registration, and promotes health, education, and solidarity in Iași

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail run in Băneasa Forest, Bucharest. It started in 2018 and has grown to more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: a half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, a 6 km fast run, and a non-competitive 3 km Family Run, suitable for runners of all levels. The race focuses on the joy of running in nature and spending time with family, and is organized by a team passionate about running. Participants can join group training sessions at different paces, led by coaches, to prepare for race day.
course_highlights: A 100% trail route in Băneasa Forest
A range of races: half marathon, 11 km, 6 km, and 3 km Family Run
Training sessions organized in groups at different paces
additional: Training sessions are organized in groups at different paces and led by coordinators. The Family Run is a non-competitive race for families. The event supports social causes through partnerships with Asociația Magic and Asociația Zi de Bine. The event includes several race categories, route details and participant instructions, as well as support for social causes.

description: IstritaXscape is a mountain running event organized by the Legendary Sports Sports Club Association, taking place on the hills, trails, and forest roads around Istrița Hill and the Sărata-Monteoru resort. The routes offer a unique experience, crossing natural and historic landscapes with traces of the Dacians, Romans, and prehistoric life. The event is for both amateur and professional runners, promoting outdoor activity and a passion for mountain running. Participants can choose from three different races, each with its own challenges and attractions.
course_highlights: Routes on the hills and trails around Istrița and Sărata-Monteoru
Scenic views of the Monteoru resort and the city of Buzău
Marked routes through forests, along forest roads, and through historic areas with traces of Dacian and Roman history
additional: The race pack includes a race bib, a medal for participants who finish within the specified time, refreshment points and support along the route, isotonic drinks at the start/finish and along the route, race results and an electronic certificate, and filming and audio/video editing. The Half Marathon and Marathon routes are for participants over 18, while Fun Run is also open to children aged 8 to 17, who must be accompanied by a parent registered for the same race. Routes of 3 km, 7.5 km, 12.5 km, and 20 km; a mountain running event in nature; the 2026 event is scheduled for November 7.

name: BUCHAREST 21K
description: Bucharest 21k is a running race that invites you to discover Romania’s capital in a unique way: by running. The course is flat, fast, and ideal for setting personal records, passing through green parks and combining old architecture with the city’s modern energy. The event is suitable for both elite runners and enthusiastic amateurs, offering a vibrant, dynamic atmosphere in the heart of Bucharest. It’s the perfect opportunity to explore a lively European city that remains undiscovered by the masses.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course, ideal for personal records
Green parks along the course
A unique blend of old architecture and modern energy
additional: The event is part of the YOLO Events series, which promotes an active, healthy lifestyle. Participants can support charitable causes through personal fundraising pages. The atmosphere is energizing, and the event is open to both elite runners and amateurs. The course includes hydration stations every 5 km and the energetic atmosphere characteristic of Romania’s capital.
